english.title: Remove a child placed for adoption by adoption agency under s.19 from prospective adopters
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) removed **(..SPECIFY NAME OR IDENTITY OF CHILD REMOVED..), a child placed for adoption by an adoption agency under section 19 of the Adoption and Children Act 2002, from the prospective adopter
english.legislation: Contrary to section 30(1)(a) and (8) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002.

english.notes:
(i) This section is subject to sections 31 to 33 but those sections do not apply if the child is subject to a care order
(ii) Sections 30 to 33 apply whether or not the child is in England or Wales
(iii) Sections 30 to 33 do not affect the exercise by any local authority or other person of any power conferred by any enactment, other than section 20(8) of the Children Act 1989 (removal of children from local authority accommodation)
(iv) Sections 30 to 33 do not prevent the removal of a child who is arrested

other.penalty:
Summary: Imprisonment for a term not exceeding three months and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
